metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Nell Sparekey
records.biography_en: In The Night Symbols, Nell Sparekey takes the role of curious threshold dreamer. “What if it fits?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: stubby oversized brass key with a round handle.

records.name: Bert Stairloop
records.biography_en: In The Night Symbols, Bert Stairloop takes the role of confused impossible-stair traveller. “I went up and arrived downstairs.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small impossible stair sculpture cupped in both hands.

records.name: Pip Mooncup
records.biography_en: In The Night Symbols, Pip Mooncup takes the role of delighted moon collector. “Tea with a small moon.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny smooth crescent resting upright in a pale teacup.

records.name: Faye Threadend
records.biography_en: In The Night Symbols, Faye Threadend takes the role of uneasy maze navigator. “I marked the way back.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: single red thread wound around a palm-sized clay labyrinth tile.

records.name: Hal Mirrorwell
records.biography_en: In The Night Symbols, Hal Mirrorwell takes the role of doubtful mirror bearer. “That reflection arrived early.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small silver-backed hand mirror angled outward, smooth face with abstract reflection.

records.name: Wes Hourglass
records.biography_en: In The Night Symbols, Wes Hourglass takes the role of weary time dreamer. “One grain at a time.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short clean glass hourglass with homogeneous warm clay sand volume.
